scientific.integrity: The defining rank-one PowerSGD matrix multiplications are iterated on a fixed rank-two matrix. Rotational invariance reduces the Gaussian initialization to a uniform angle, and the expected residual is evaluated exactly by an elementary circle integral.
limitations: Fixed rank-two matrix with rank-one compression.
Standard Gaussian initial right factor and exact source warm-start reuse.
No optimizer-level convergence claim for changing stochastic gradients.
General higher-rank or larger-spectrum formulas are not asserted.

title: PowerSGD warm-start has an exact rank-two error law
